kids: Decorate an ornament to take home
Sip hot cocoa with the family
about: Greeley Parks and Recreation hosts Jingle Bell Jam at the Family FunPlex.
The 2026 date is Friday, December 18, from 5 to 8 PM.
The Family FunPlex is at 1501 65th Avenue on Greeley's west side.
Admission is free.
Santa and Mrs. Claus are on hand for visits.
Hot cocoa is served during the evening.
Kids can decorate an ornament.
The city describes it as an evening of holiday magic for the whole family.
The event runs indoors at the recreation center.
It is one of several Greeley Recreation holiday events this month.
The City of Greeley events calendar carries the listing.

kids: Skate with Santa on the ice
Get your face painted and make crafts
about: Lace up at the Greeley Ice Haus, where Santa joins the skaters for an afternoon session.
The session runs Saturday, December 19, 2026, noon to 1:30 PM.
Find the rink at 900 8th Avenue, close to downtown.
One $15 ticket covers admission and rental skates.
A free skating lesson is built into the session, handy for first timers.
Hot cocoa is served.
Face painting and crafts are on offer.
Families can have pictures taken with Santa.
The Zamboni is part of the fun.
Visit Greeley describes it as another Santa sighting, this time on the ice.
The City of Greeley events calendar carries the listing.

kids: Make holiday crafts in a historic village
about: Homesteader's Holiday turns Centennial Village Museum into a Christmas past scene.
Doors are open Saturday, December 12, 2026, noon to 6 PM.
The village sits at 1475 A Street.
The city invites visitors to step back into Christmas past at the village.
Historical homes and pathways are decked for the holidays.
Holiday crafts and music are part of the day.
Old-fashioned candle dipping is offered.
Adults pay $8, youth ages 7 to 17 and seniors pay $6, and a family of 3 to 5 pays $20.
Children 6 and under are free.
Visitors with demonstrated need (SNAP or EBT) enter free.
Visit Greeley adds that caroling and visits with Cowboy Santa are part of the holiday weekend.
The City of Greeley events calendar carries the listing.
